keyPoints.en: Informal email: Hi/Dear + name → friendly opening → short paragraphs → closing line → Take care, + name.
keyPoints.bm: E-mel tidak formal: Hi/Dear + nama → pembukaan mesra → perenggan pendek → ayat penutup → Take care, + nama.

keyPoints.en: Use contractions and a chatty tone; answer every question your friend asked.
keyPoints.bm: Gunakan kontraksi dan nada santai; jawab setiap soalan yang ditanya kawan.

keyPoints.en: Show, don't tell; use dialogue, the five senses and strong verbs.
keyPoints.bm: Tunjuk, jangan beritahu; gunakan dialog, lima deria dan kata kerja yang kuat.

tip.en: Avoid "It was all a dream" endings.

keyPoints.en: Article: catchy title, engaging opening (question), clear paragraphs, call to action.
keyPoints.bm: Rencana: tajuk menarik, pembukaan memikat (soalan), perenggan jelas, seruan bertindak.

keyPoints.en: Review: what it is, strengths, weaknesses, rating and recommendation.
keyPoints.bm: Ulasan: apakah ia, kekuatan, kelemahan, penilaian dan cadangan.
